name: TripPlanning

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations about places people want to travel to in the future.

sound_effects_config.default_background: cozy home evening ambiance with faint city sounds

initial_prompt: Create a conversation where roommates talk about places they would love to travel to someday. The home assistant listens and occasionally offers help with remembering destinations or organizing travel ideas.

variations.context: Talking about dream trips and realistic travel goals

setting.relationship_dynamic: Close friends who enjoy daydreaming together
setting.background: They rely on their home assistant to keep track of future travel ideas

scenario_template.topic: Someone talks about a place they recently saw online or heard about
scenario_template.note: Describing why the place sounds appealing

scenario_template.topic: Asking for more destination ideas based on preferences
Debating which trips are more realistic soon vs later
Assistant offers to list ONLY the destinations mentioned in this conversation
Assistant helps outline a loose order of trips

user1.name: DreamerRoommate
user1.role: Roommate who has lots of ideas, likes to daydream a lot

user2.name: PracticalRoommate
user2.role: Roommate who is practical, sticks to reasonable plans

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Home assistant that listens to home discussions and offers to recall the discussions and provides new ideas
